title: Jet Engine Noise Suppressors including Fire Suppression Systems Repair & Installation
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE LIFE CYCLE MANAGEMENT CENTER.COMBAT READINESS.FA8534  AFLCMC WNKAC
detail_text: This special notice is for an Industry Day notification for the Jet Engine Noise Suppressors including Fire Suppression Systems Repair & Installation (Hush House). Please see the information regarding Industry Day below: Date: 27 May 2026 Time: 0930-1600 Venue: Georgia VECTR Center (Veterans Education Career Transition Resource) Center 1001 S Armed Forces Blvd, Warner Robins, GA 31088 **or** Virtual option may be provided via Microsoft Teams (meeting link will be sent based on expressed interest) In order to RSVP for attendance to Industry Day, please send an email to Wesley Hardy (wesley.hardy@us.af.mil), Anna Isom (anna.isom@us.af.mil) and Alyssa Spencer (alyssa.spencer@us.af.mil). *Briefing materials will be posted in the near future and breakout sessions will be scheduled upon receipt of your RSVP.
